fields.Position Description: Help staff catalogue boxes, enter folder labels into a tracking spreadsheet, and check materials in and out of a reading room. Scan paper flyers, keep dated digital copies organized, and flag duplicate accession numbers. Work independently, keep accurate records, and communicate clearly with the team.
fields.Qualifications: Students interested in libraries, records, or campus history. Comfort with spreadsheets and careful data entry is an asset.
fields.Department / Unit Overview: A fictional campus archives used only as a sample posting. Work-study students would interact with librarians and other student workers.
fields.Skills: Communication Organization and Records Management Professionalism Teamwork Spreadsheets
